import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import KFold
from sklearn.linear_model import Ridge
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);X=rng.normal(size=(50,3));y=X[:,0]+rng.normal(size=50)
pred=np.zeros(50)
for tr,te in KFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=0).split(X):
    pred[te]=Ridge().fit(X[tr],y[tr]).predict(X[te])
print(pred[:5])
